_provenance.note: Michigan citation authorities. Policy is split across two manuals cited by number: the Bridges Eligibility Manual ('BEM 213') and the Bridges Administrative Manual ('BAM 117'), both amended by numbered Bridges Policy Bulletins ('BPB 2026-007'). Dollar tables live in the Reference Tables Manual ('RFT 255'), amended by Reference Table Bulletins ('RFB 2025-006'). Some BEM/BAM numbers carry a trailing letter (BEM 230B, BAM 401E) that the regex preserves. The statewide glossary (BPG) is cited by section name in prose, not as a numbered citation, and carries no extraction pattern.
